_doc: The single-station test sites of mppp.ibr (Christian, 10 Nov 2026: 'We'll use these three as the test sites ... the single sites should come from a config file'). python -m mppp single-sites [LABEL ...] runs them: the dense step in the block, then mesh / depthmaps --photometry / ods into <out>/<label>/ (rover masked out) and <out>/<label>/with_rover/ (rover shown). Per station: 'site' (a site of mppp/data/sites.json; the block is its Navcam WORK folder) or 'work' (a block folder), 'station' (S003D2046 / 3_2046), 'frames' (the dense step's frames: 'images' [names], 'scale' (0.5: the half-resolution frames), 'sequences' [NCAM...]); optional 'variants' (rover, masked; the rover shown is the default since 0.96.1, run first), 'ods_exclude' (frames left out of the panorama, both eyes of a pair: an NLF stem drops its NRF partner), 'mesh_args' / 'depthmaps_args' / 'ods_args' (extra arguments), 'note'. Top level: 'dense_args' / 'mesh_args' / 'depthmaps_args' / 'ods_args' for every station (and per station the same keys); 'ods_args' --bits 16: the panorama from 16-bit linear frames. 0.97.0 (Christian, 12 Nov 2026): run by run_single_site_ibr.bat; 'ods_args' --eyes left right centre adds the panorama from the pivot (<station>[_rover]_ods_centre.png, _centre_16.png) and its depth (_centre_depth.npz, _depth_16.png, _depth_linear.jpg, _depth_log.jpg); the driver gives both variants of a station one <out>/<label>/tone_levels.json so their 16-to-8-bit scaling is the same; the pivot is on the azimuth axis at the Mastcam-Z height (--pivot-height zcam, the default) whatever cameras are rendered. 0.97.7 (Christian, 13 Nov 2026): per station 'name', the site's name in the mark at the panorama's nadir (default: from 'site'); 'ods_args' --fill-cameras F: the station's front Hazcam pair colours the terrain the Navcam frames do not see (under the arm). 0.97.8: 'depthmaps_args' --add-cameras F: the front Hazcam pair also gets its depth and photometric maps. 0.97.11: the centre panorama is no longer rendered (it took a third of the time; --eyes left right centre in 'ods_args' brings it back); the depth from the pivot is still made, from rays alone. 0.97.14 (Christian, 13 Nov 2026): the stations' labels carry the sol of their frames, Sol0052_S003D2046 - the folder <out>/<label>/ and the files' prefix; the dense workspace in the block stays dense_S003D2046, and the old label still selects the station on the command line. 0.97.14: the per-image maps (depthmaps) are made for the terrain-only variant alone ('depthmaps_variants': ["masked"]; ["rover", "masked"] for both) and hold depth and normals; 'photometry': true (top level or per station) adds incidence, emission, phase and shadow. 0.97.15 (Christian, 13 Nov 2026): per station 'context' [names]: frames of the block from another place, or from this place on another sol - added to the dense step's frames (terrain) and given to mppp ods --context-images (fill-only sources, their rover mask applied in both variants, never on the rover model); 0.97.19: with any way of choosing the station's frames (mppp dense --add-images). 0.97.17 (Christian, 13 Nov 2026: 'the name of the ods should just be its block name without any large, huge, or tiny additions'): the name in the mark and in the viewer's title is the block's label in sites.json without its size word (van_zyl_overlook_huge: Van Zyl Overlook; witch_hazel_large: Witch Hazel Hill); the stations carry no 'name' any more ('name' still overrides).
